# Account and access configuration — fictional snapshot

Source identity: `https://docs.relaymesh.invalid/admin/access`; body captured successfully on 2026-11-04.

RelayMesh uses the customer's identity provider for sign-in. Configure MFA there. In the central console, Access → Policy editor controls service grants; rules are additive and support positive and negative tests. These interfaces and defaults have been unchanged since 2025.

The console's Devices → Device details → Attributes panel displays reported posture values. It does not configure host/daemon security preferences.
